title: SCA Minhag of the Week 162: "Tefilla BeSibbur: Shabbat Minha Amida until Alenu"
summary: Mr. Harari discusses the customs of the Halabi community regarding the Shabbat Minha service following the Amida. He covers the practice of Tahanun, the recitation of Mizmor Halleluyah, and the concluding prayers leading up to Aleinu.
questions: Do we stand or sit for Tahanun during Shabbat Minha?
Is Mizmor Halleluyah sung in unison by the Kahal?
What happens if a holiday falls on Shabbat during Minha?
Does the Halabi community say Yehi Shem after Tahanun?
